Title: Product model instantiation
Preconditions: Fresh model instance
Steps: 1. Create new Product instance 2. Populate properties (sku, barcode, product_name, cost_price, selling_price, current_stock, stock_threshold)
ExpectedResult: Product instance created with all properties set

Title: Product SKU uniqueness validation
Preconditions: Database seeded with 1 product
Steps: 1. Attempt to create second product with same SKU 2. Validate request
ExpectedResult: Validation error: SKU already exists (422 Unprocessable Entity)

Title: Product barcode uniqueness validation
Preconditions: Database seeded with 1 product
Steps: 1. Attempt to create product with same barcode as existing 2. Validate exception
ExpectedResult: Validation error: Barcode already exists (422 Unprocessable Entity)

Title: Stock calculation after purchase
Preconditions: Product exists with initial_stock=10, purchase_quantity=5
Steps: 1. Create Purchase record 2. Create PurchaseItem linked to product 3. Execute StockService::updateStockAfterPurchase() 4. Query product.current_stock
ExpectedResult: current_stock = 15 (10 + 5), StockHistory entry created with type 'purchase'

Title: Stock calculation after sale (sufficient stock)
Preconditions: Product exists with current_stock=20, sale_quantity=5
Steps: 1. Create Sale record 2. Create SaleItem linked to product 3. Execute StockService::updateStockAfterSale() 4. Query product.current_stock
ExpectedResult: current_stock = 15 (20 - 5), StockHistory entry created with type 'sale'

Title: Stock calculation prevents overselling
Preconditions: Product exists with current_stock=3, sale_quantity=5
Steps: 1. Attempt to create Sale with 5 items 2. Validate exception
ExpectedResult: Sale creation fails with error 'Insufficient stock: only 3 available' (422 Unprocessable Entity)

Title: Manual stock adjustment logging
Preconditions: Product with current_stock=10, StockAdjustment not yet recorded
Steps: 1. Create StockAdjustment (old_qty=10, new_qty=12, reason='Received returns') 2. Query StockHistory
ExpectedResult: StockHistory record created with transaction_type='adjustment', quantity_change=2, reason logged

Title: Low-stock alert generation
Preconditions: Product exists with current_stock=2, stock_threshold=5
Steps: 1. Run AlertService::checkLowStockProducts() 2. Query alerts table for product
ExpectedResult: Alert record created with product_id, status='unresolved'

Title: Sale model relationships
Preconditions: Fresh Sale instance with customer_id, user_id, sale_items collection
Steps: 1. Load Sale with includes(['customer', 'user', 'items']) 2. Access each relationship
ExpectedResult: customer, user, and items accessible; no N+1 queries

Title: Purchase order total calculation
Preconditions: Purchase created with 2 PurchaseItems (qty=5@$10, qty=3@$20)
Steps: 1. Execute PurchaseService::calculateTotal() 2. Query purchase.total_amount
ExpectedResult: total_amount = 110 (5*10 + 3*20)

Title: User login returns valid token
Preconditions: Valid user (admin@test.local) seeded in database
Steps: 1. POST /api/v1/login with email and password 2. Capture response
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200, response contains access_token, token_type='Bearer', user object

Title: Invalid credentials return 401
Preconditions: Test user seeded
Steps: 1. POST /api/v1/login with wrong password 2. Capture response
ExpectedResult: HTTP 401 Unauthorized, error message: 'The provided credentials are invalid'

Title: Authenticated user can access products
Preconditions: User logged in with valid token (admin or staff)
Steps: 1. GET /api/v1/products with Authorization header 2. Validate response
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200, returns paginated product list (JSON array with id, sku, barcode, product_name, prices, stock)

Title: Unauthenticated request rejected
Preconditions: No authentication token
Steps: 1. GET /api/v1/products without Authorization header 2. Capture response
ExpectedResult: HTTP 401 Unauthorized, error: 'Unauthenticated'

Title: Create product with valid data
Preconditions: Admin user logged in, categories and suppliers seeded
Steps: 1. POST /api/v1/products with {sku='SKU001', barcode='BAR001', product_name='Desk', cost_price=100, selling_price=150, current_stock=10, stock_threshold=5, category_id=1, supplier_id=1} 2. Validate response
ExpectedResult: HTTP 201, returns created product object with all fields populated

Title: Create product with duplicate SKU rejected
Preconditions: Admin logged in, product with SKU='EXISTING' already exists
Steps: 1. POST /api/v1/products with sku='EXISTING' 2. Validate response
ExpectedResult: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity, error: 'The sku has already been taken'

Title: Get product by ID
Preconditions: Product with ID=1 exists, user authenticated
Steps: 1. GET /api/v1/products/1 2. Validate response
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200, returns product object with all details, relationships (category, supplier)

Title: Update product details
Preconditions: Product with ID=1 exists, admin logged in
Steps: 1. PUT /api/v1/products/1 with {selling_price=200, stock_threshold=8} 2. Validate response
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200, returns updated product with new values

Title: Delete product (soft delete)
Preconditions: Product with ID=1 exists, admin logged in, no sales/purchases reference it
Steps: 1. DELETE /api/v1/products/1 2. Validate response
ExpectedResult: HTTP 204 No Content, product marked as deleted (soft delete)

Title: Create purchase order
Preconditions: Supplier with ID=1 exists, admin logged in, product IDs seeded
Steps: 1. POST /api/v1/purchases with {supplier_id=1, payment_method='cash', items=[{product_id=1, quantity=5, unit_price=100}]} 2. Validate response
ExpectedResult: HTTP 201, purchase created, status='pending', stock auto-updated for product (current_stock+=5), StockHistory logged

Title: Create sale transaction
Preconditions: Customer with ID=1 exists, staff logged in, product with stock=20 exists
Steps: 1. POST /api/v1/sales with {customer_id=1, payment_method='cash', items=[{product_id=1, quantity=5, unit_price=150}]} 2. Validate response
ExpectedResult: HTTP 201, sale created, status='completed', product stock decremented (current_stock-=5), StockHistory logged

Title: Sale validation prevents overselling
Preconditions: Product with current_stock=2 exists, customer seeded, staff logged in
Steps: 1. POST /api/v1/sales with item requesting quantity=5 2. Validate response
ExpectedResult: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity, error: 'Insufficient stock for product ID 1'

Title: Manual stock adjustment
Preconditions: Product with current_stock=100 exists, admin logged in
Steps: 1. POST /api/v1/stock-adjustments with {product_id=1, new_quantity=95, reason='Physical count discrepancy'} 2. Validate response
ExpectedResult: HTTP 201, StockAdjustment record created, StockHistory entry logged with type='adjustment', quantity_change=-5

Title: Generate sales report
Preconditions: Multiple sales created, staff logged in
Steps: 1. GET /api/v1/reports/sales?date_from=2026-01-01&date_to=2026-02-14 2. Validate response
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200, returns array of sales with totals, itemized breakdown, grouped by date/customer

Title: Generate purchase report
Preconditions: Multiple purchases created, staff logged in
Steps: 1. GET /api/v1/reports/purchases?date_from=2026-01-01&date_to=2026-02-14 2. Validate response
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200, returns array of purchases with totals, itemized breakdown, grouped by supplier

Title: Stock levels report
Preconditions: Products seeded with various stock levels
Steps: 1. GET /api/v1/reports/stock-levels 2. Validate response
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200, returns all products with current_stock, stock_threshold, below-threshold flag

Title: Inventory valuation report
Preconditions: Products with cost_price and current_stock set
Steps: 1. GET /api/v1/reports/inventory-valuation 2. Validate response
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200, returns total inventory value (sum of cost_price * current_stock)

Title: User role-based access (Admin vs Staff)
Preconditions: Admin and Staff users seeded, both authenticated
Steps: 1. Admin creates new product (allowed) 2. Staff attempts user creation (should fail)
ExpectedResult: Admin: HTTP 201, Staff: HTTP 403 Forbidden

Title: Complete sales workflow
Preconditions: Supplier, product, customer seeded. Staff logged in.
Steps: 1. Create purchase order for 10 units 2. Verify stock was incremented 3. Create sale for 5 units 4. Verify stock decremented 5. Check stock history has 2 entries
ExpectedResult: Purchase and Sale created. Stock: 10→15 (after purchase), 15→10 (after sale). StockHistory has 2 entries (purchase + sale).

Title: Low-stock alert notification
Preconditions: Product A: stock=3, threshold=5 (alert condition). Product B: stock=10, threshold=5 (no alert)
Steps: 1. Run cron job or manual AlertService::checkAndCreateAlerts() 2. Query alerts table for recent entries
ExpectedResult: Alert created for Product A only. Product B has no new alert. Dashboard shows 1 unresolved alert.

Title: Dashboard displays metrics
Preconditions: Multiple sales, purchases, stock adjustments recorded
Steps: 1. Navigate to /dashboard 2. View metrics widgets
ExpectedResult: Dashboard shows: Total Sales (sum), Total Purchases (sum), Low-stock Products count, Recent transactions list

Title: Logout invalidates token
Preconditions: User logged in with valid token
Steps: 1. POST /api/v1/logout with Authorization header 2. Attempt GET /api/v1/products with old token
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200 on logout. HTTP 401 on subsequent request (token revoked).

Title: Pagination works on product list
Preconditions: 30 products seeded
Steps: 1. GET /api/v1/products?page=1&per_page=10 2. GET /api/v1/products?page=2
ExpectedResult: Page 1 returns 10 products. Page 2 returns next 10 products. Meta contains total, current_page, per_page.

Title: Search/filter products by category
Preconditions: Products with different categories seeded
Steps: 1. GET /api/v1/products?category_id=2 2. Validate results
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200, returns only products with category_id=2

Title: Barcode scanner integration (simulated)
Preconditions: Product with barcode='1234567890' exists
Steps: 1. Simulate barcode scanner input (POST /api/v1/products/scan with barcode='1234567890') 2. Capture response
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200, returns product details for matching barcode

Title: API response time < 500ms under normal load
Preconditions: 10 concurrent users, 100 products in database
Steps: 1. Load test /api/v1/products with ApacheBench or Locust 2. Measure response time
ExpectedResult: Mean response time < 500ms, P95 < 1000ms

Title: Stock update transaction atomicity
Preconditions: Database transaction monitoring enabled
Steps: 1. Start purchase creation 2. Trigger error mid-transaction (e.g., invalid supplier) 3. Rollback 4. Verify stock unchanged
ExpectedResult: Stock returns to initial state. StockHistory has no partial entries. All-or-nothing semantics preserved.

Title: Database connection pooling
Preconditions: Concurrent API requests from integration tests
Steps: 1. Run 50 concurrent API requests 2. Monitor database connections
ExpectedResult: Apache connection pool used efficiently. No connection leaks. Max 10 connections used.

Title: SQL query optimization (N+1 prevention)
Preconditions: GET /api/v1/sales endpoint with eager loading configured
Steps: 1. GET /api/v1/sales with 100 sale records 2. Count SQL queries executed
ExpectedResult: < 5 total queries (1 for sales, 1 for customers, 1 for items, 1 for products, 1 for users). No N+1 pattern.

Title: Security: SQL injection prevention
Preconditions: SQL injection payload in query parameters
Steps: 1. GET /api/v1/products?category_id=1 OR 1=1 2. GET /api/v1/products?name=\'; DROP TABLE products; --\""
ExpectedResult: Queries safely parameterized. No error leakage. Payload treated as literal string.

Title: Security: Unauthorized access prevention
Preconditions: Unauthenticated request, invalid token
Steps: 1. Access /api/v1/products without token 2. Access with expired/invalid token
ExpectedResult: HTTP 401 Unauthorized for both cases. No data leakage.

Title: Security: CSRF token validation
Preconditions: POST /api/v1/purchases without CSRF token (if web routes used)
Steps: 1. POST without token header 2. POST with mismatched token
ExpectedResult: HTTP 419 Expired Token or 403 (depending on flow). Valid CSRF token accepted.

Title: Data encryption at rest (optional)
Preconditions: Database backup taken
Steps: 1. Verify sensitive fields (password hashes, etc.) not stored in plaintext
ExpectedResult: Passwords hashed with bcrypt or similar. Email not encrypted but hashed indexes used.

Title: Audit logging for sensitive operations
Preconditions: Admin creates/deletes user, updates product price
Steps: 1. Perform each operation 2. Query audit_logs or activity_log table
ExpectedResult: Entries logged with user_id, action, affected_resource, timestamp. Tamper-evident.

Title: Data retention policy (soft deletes)
Preconditions: Product marked as deleted
Steps: 1. Query products with trashed() scope 2. Restore deleted product
ExpectedResult: Soft-deleted records hidden from normal queries. Accessible with trashed() or forceDelete().

Title: System boots and migrations run without error
Preconditions: Fresh database, docker-compose or XAMPP running
Steps: 1. php artisan migrate 2. php artisan serve 3. Access /api/v1/login endpoint
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200, system ready. All tables created. No migration errors.

Title: Seeders populate test data correctly
Preconditions: Fresh database after migration
Steps: 1. php artisan db:seed 2. Count records in users, roles, products, categories, suppliers, customers tables
ExpectedResult: Admin user exists. Staff user exists. 5 categories. 10 products. 3 suppliers. 3 customers. All relationships intact.

Title: API documentation accuracy
Preconditions: Postman collection created, API endpoints implemented
Steps: 1. Compare endpoints in collection vs actual codebase 2. Compare request/response formats
ExpectedResult: All 20+ endpoints documented. Request param names match code. Response structures match README.
